newsitem.title: HONG KONG: OLS Group debuts at HK$1.69 per share.
newsitem.headline: OLS Group debuts at HK$1.69 per share.

text.p: Shares of construction firm OLS Group Ltd made their trading debut on Thursday at HK$1.69 per share, just above the issue price of HK$1.65.
The share then slipped to HK$1.49 in early trade.
OLS Group, a unit of OLS Asia Holdings Ltd, offered 120 million new shares at HK$1.65 each.
The 108 million shares for public subscription were about 16.95 times subscribed, while the 12 million shares to company employees were fully allotted.
The company said it would use the proceeds to finance existing and prospective projects in Hong Kong, China and Malaysia.
